notes: Scheduled texts, Undo after Send, templates, and tap numbers, links and codes in your texts

changes.text: Send a text later: long-press Send, or tap the clock, and choose a time. It goes even with the app closed or after a restart
Undo after Send: a sent text waits 5 seconds so you can take it back (Settings › Undo send)
Templates: save replies in Settings › Templates and put them in a text with the templates button or by typing /shortcut
Numbers, links, emails and one-time codes in texts can be tapped: call, open, copy; a code copies at once
Copy code on the notification of a text with a one-time code
A new icon, and an animated start
A conversation could not be left (Back did nothing) after the phone's connection came back
